title: I made a free starfox like 16 player arena mini-game. Battle Mecha Jensen Huang to free up the GPU supply.
author: SloppySteaks3
selftext: [https://github.com/sloppysteaks69/GPU-Bandits](https://github.com/sloppysteaks69/GPU-Bandits) It supports up to 16 players over direct IP or bots. There's a co-op mode where the goal is to kill mecha huang and save GPU chips for gamers. There's also a pure death match.

replies.author: SloppySteaks3
replies.body: oof that's embarrassing, it's public now
